cohort: 928 women who gave birth at South Gondar Health Institutions in 2021
finding: The study found a high proportion of adverse birth outcomes, with previous history of abortion, ANC follow-up, premature rupture of membrane, hyperemesis, obstructed labor, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, and cesarean birth significantly associated with fetal adverse outcomes, and antepartum hemorrhage associated with maternal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was significantly associated with a lower risk of fetal adverse birth outcomes (AOR = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.28, 0.88).
